scope.purpose: Development-only calibration of hybrid matching attachment and review thresholds.
scope.label_caveat: Challenge relationships are synthetic scenario assumptions. Underdetermined means available report wording does not establish identity; an attachment is an unsafe or unjustified action for review, not proof that the underlying incidents differ.
limitations: The 48-pair challenge is small and synthetic; zero explicit-different auto-attachments is not a safety guarantee.
Review suggestions are intentionally measured separately from attachments and are noisy: some explicit-different and all cue-free negative cases receive candidates.
Thresholds are development choices, not evidence of unseen-data generalization.

The selected profile leaves the four changing-exit DEV reports in separate predicted groups, with no within-incident Conflict objects. Final-source review warnings cite the opposing claims across groups, and the real API check verified conflict preservation through coordinator merging.

model.name: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
model.device_selection: SentenceTransformer default device; verified with the same local pinned loader after the sweep.

predeclared_selection_objective.primary: Among profiles with zero explicit-different automatic attachment cases on the 48-pair challenge, maximize original DEV ordered-runtime pairwise recall.
predeclared_selection_objective.underdetermined_policy: Report underdetermined automatic attachments separately; do not optimize against their assumed labels.
predeclared_selection_objective.selection_result: The selected profile is the highest-threshold member of the .70–.76 attach plateau with 22/66 DEV positive-pair recall, zero explicit-different challenge auto-attachments, and zero DEV false merges.

ordered_runtime.same_event_candidate_evidence_recall_def: 38 of 40 repeated same-event incoming reports had at least one candidate from their gold group; this is report-level candidate coverage, not pairwise recall over all 66 positive pairs.

dev-004: Known event time and a specific shared sublocation or described entity are required for attachment.
A known location, time, category, or entity incompatibility keeps this report separate.
dev-022: A review candidate is available, but no route passed the automatic attachment gates.
dev-040: Anchor similarity is insufficient; a strong member match cannot create a transitive bridge.
dev-057: MiniLM candidate margin is below 0.08; the close runner-up is shown for coordinator review.

current_lexical_only_counterfactual.method: forced lexical fallback on current hybrid source; no MiniLM vectors available to route
current_lexical_only_counterfactual.interpretation: Against this same current engine, removing dense vectors raises identifiable different-event false attachments from 0/18 to 15/18, while increasing same-event automatic attachments from 12/18 to 17/18. This is a forced-fallback counterfactual, not a separately calibrated lexical production profile.

cross_encoder_followup.decision: Do not integrate; the small STS reranker did not separate same-incident paraphrases from hard negatives and underdetermined pairs reliably.

changing_exit_workflow.preserved_conflict_signal_definition: Only within-predicted-group Conflict objects are counted here; cross-report review warnings are recorded separately.

post_sweep_source_validation.conclusion: Challenge attachment counts and DEV grouping/membership metrics match the original selected-profile sweep. The final source has one fewer DEV report-level review flag (60 to 59); it does not change scores, selected groups, or attachment counts.

cross_report_conflict_review_visibility.definition: An explicit source-cited warning in choose_group.review_reasons, independently of within-incident Conflict objects.

warnings: Potential conflicting or changing accounts; compare report IDs dev-057 and dev-004: exit_access is clear (“doorway is open”) versus blocked (“Exit A door is stuck”).

cross_report_conflict_review_visibility.limitations: The reports remain in separate predicted groups; this warning invites coordinator comparison and does not assert they are one incident.

calibrated_lexical_control.method: Forced lexical fallback on the final hybrid source, with dense vectors unavailable; no model inference. All shared context, hard conflict, entity, rejection, anchor, and runner-up behavior remained as in the engine; only the lexical attach threshold varied.
calibrated_lexical_control.predeclared_objective: Among forced lexical profiles with zero explicit-different automatic attachment cases on the 48-pair challenge, maximize original DEV ordered-runtime pairwise recall; ties prefer fewer DEV false merges, then higher lexical attach threshold. Underdetermined labels are reported separately and do not affect selection.
calibrated_lexical_control.comparison_note: The zero-explicit-different lexical profile selected by the same objective has 0/66 DEV pair recall. The hybrid profile at .76/.65 has 22/66, with zero explicit-different false attachments on the development challenge. This is a synthetic development comparison, not a generalization guarantee.

real_model_api.method: FastAPI TestClient through actual ingestion, SQLite persistence, replay and coordinator review; real offline pinned MiniLM, no fake encoder.

clean_committed_tree.dependencies: Installed locked dependencies reused; no untracked application files used.
